name: 星辰服
description:
✦ Farming and retirement, accompanied by the stars ✦

—740 days, we have made a home in this world.

This isn't a flashy server; it's a place where a group of MCs fans have been playing seriously for almost two years.

The server launched on April 26, 2024, and it's been 740 days since then. Never changed my save file, not even once. Every brick you lay, every vegetable you plant, is waiting for you in place.

What kind of place is this?

Simply put, it's a farmer's Lei's survival costume. The pace isn't fast, it doesn't push you to grind, and it doesn't dazzle your eyes with flashy things. You can quietly farm, cook, and raise animals, working all day just to have one more dish on the dinner table—well, you can feel that sense of security in the game too.

The version is Bedrock 1.26.10, a long-term public service server, with no pay-to-win routines.

IP：103.39.66.10

Acceleration IP: vip.vanmc.cn

Port: 12999

If the acceleration IP can't get in, just switch to the default IP and check your personal network.

We used to be a group of "homeless" people

It's a bit bittersweet to say. Previously, everyone played together in the NetEase version of "Wonderland Home" in the Fengyun guild, but the servers suddenly shut down and the group scattered.

The server master Ju Miao was unwilling to give up. She started as a newbie who couldn't even read the English integration package and needed to take a photo and translate with her phone, then managed to create her own server. On April 26, 2024, Starwatch launched.

Looking back now, the fact that this server has survived to today is truly thanks to the love of a group of people. Special thanks to the veteran sponsors Li, Mengda, and Mumuxi. Without them, the service side would have been stuck long ago.

What can you play?

The core is just one thing: getting by.
